paragraphs: In [Chullin 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.38a.14): Ravina said, “Sama bar Chilkai told me: Bar Avuvram’s father raised a difficulty on it,” etc.
In [Zevachim 103a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.103a.17) he raised an objection to Ravina: “Is a convert not a person?”[^1]

notes.text: In Chullin Ravina quotes Sama, who relays an objection from Bar Avuvram’s father, or in another reading his brother. The consulted Zevachim instead names Rav Simai and has ish where Hyman has inish.
